supersedes: results/testbed_prereg_v4lite/preregistration.json (never run; v4-lite is an arm here, on T1B)
plan: docs/v5_plan.md, docs/v4lite_plan.md; selection in results/v5 and results/v4lite (development data only)
setup: domain T1B: the last 60 % of bigFlows, which no model or threshold was trained or calibrated on (every T1 model and tau, ours and the baselines', from T1A); tree3 (core s11 + access s12/s13, tables 3,500, idle 10 s, all monitored), benign scale 0.5, one controller, 300 s, attack at 50 s, new-connection probe every 0.5 s

defenses.ensguard: v3 as preregistered in v3 (RF + CatBoost, v3 block rule), tau T1B from T1A
defenses.ensguard-v4lite: CatBoost only, floored block rule (m0 10, f 0.2), changed-entry scoring, tau T1B from T1A (= v5 without the volume block)
defenses.ensguard-v5: v4-lite + volume block (host > X entries and >= 3 x median host at >= 90 % occupancy; X per switch 800 / 785 / 797 from T1A benign recordings)
defenses.dms-btt: DMS-BTT with blocklist (revision 2 knobs), state and flow models trained on T1A (A1-A3 + benign)
defenses.ftmaster: FTMaster (E2 knobs), state and rule models trained on T1A (A1-A3 + benign)

test: one-sided exact sign test on the 15 paired attack runs (A2, A4, E9P x 5 seeds; same variant, same seed); a tie counts against the hypothesis; Holm within each hypothesis over its comparators; alpha 0.05

hypotheses.H1: ensguard-v5 harms fewer benign flows (benign_harmed_pct) than each of dms-btt and ftmaster (Holm over the 2)
hypotheses.H2: ensguard-v5 has a lower average attack share of the core table (attack_share_avg_pct_s11) than each of dms-btt and ftmaster (Holm over the 2)
hypotheses.H3: ensguard-v5 harms fewer benign flows than ensguard v3
hypotheses.H4: ensguard-v5 has a shorter mean decision time per poll (decision_ms mean) than ensguard v3
hypotheses.H5: no benign host is blocked in any of ensguard-v5's 20 runs (descriptive)
hypotheses.H6: benign-only runs of ensguard-v5: mean harm <= 0.5 % and mean lost first packets <= 1 % (descriptive)
hypotheses.H7: guard: ensguard-v5's new-connection success (probe_post_success_pct) is not worse than v3's: a pair fails when v5 is more than 5 points below v3; H7 fails at 8 or more failed pairs of 15
hypotheses.H8: ensguard-v5 has a lower average attack share at s11 than ensguard-v4lite (the volume block's effect)

reported_without_test: per variant: lost first packets, benign flows dropped by rules, attack share avg / max at s11-s13, seconds at the limit, Packet-In, Table-Full, probe success and connect time, hosts blocked (attack, benign) and first block time, decision time, CPU and memory; all comparisons with none and ensguard-v4lite not listed above
validity: a run is valid if the controller logs to >= 90 % of the duration and the wall time is <= 1.5 x + 60 s (matrix_e5.sh); an invalid run is rerun once with the same seed and reported
known_limitations: 5 seeds: a hypothesis needs 12 of 15 wins (Holm over 2: 12 or 13)
